text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... To tell you the truth, my 
head's been throbbing since this 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So I thought maybe if I distracted
myself 
with fishing, I wouldn't notice the 
headache as much..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I just focus solely on the fishing
line 
like this... Focus... focus...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: ...Maybe it's not good to focus so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It seems so...
...To think I won't even 
be able to go fishing, my favorite 
thing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that,
Cheval Grand continued to 
be troubled by a headache...
